notes: Publisher sources collected as news. Items are kept when they explicitly concern the DRC, or flagged as regional context when they concern the Great Lakes neighbours. 'site' restricts item links to the publisher's own domain. 'mode': 'feed' (default) stores the feed's title and lede only (coverage 'feed_summary'); 'feed_full_text' reads the feed, then fetches each new article page (robots.txt checked, paced at max(page_delay_seconds, Crawl-delay)) for the full body; 'listing' discovers dated article links on the homepage and 'listing_paths' when no feed exists; 'reliefweb_api' queries the ReliefWeb API and needs RELIEFWEB_APPNAME. 'max_pages' bounds article-page fetches per poll; 'poll_seconds' overrides FEED_POLL_SECONDS for one source.

feeds.name: Jeune Afrique
feeds.access_note: Article pages sit behind a bot challenge and many require a subscription. Collected from the publisher's official feed: title, lede, author, section and publication time, linked to the original.

feeds.name: Radio Okapi
feeds.access_note: UN radio in the DRC run by MONUSCO. Read from its news feed (/feed/actualite; the site-wide /rss.xml lists only stale admin pages), then each article page for the full text. robots.txt allows article pages with Crawl-delay: 10, which is honoured. The feed summary is kept when a page cannot be fetched and the page is retried on later polls.

feeds.name: 7sur7.cd
feeds.access_note: Private Kinshasa news site without a feed. New dated articles (/YYYY/MM/DD/slug) are discovered on the homepage and four section pages and fetched for the full text; robots.txt is checked before every request and requests are spaced at least 5 s apart.

feeds.name: ReliefWeb
feeds.access_note: UN OCHA humanitarian reports whose primary country is the DRC, from the ReliefWeb API (an approved appname is required; reliefweb.int pages are never scraped). Each report belongs to its contributing organisation, credited as the source; reports published only as attachments are skipped.
